answer: Divergence between two jury outputs triggers a slash, and the case goes to a second panel instead of being settled by the first. Over 40 epochs that costs a false accuser a bond about as often as it catches a liar. A copied answer returns an identical echo, so replay finds it whatever name is attached. The knoll is cost per case: one bond per panel, no volume discount, and five seats through a prism cost five times one payout.
